note: SL8 wording, restated from the HeyGen legacy avatar-video skill (heygen-com/skills-legacy, outside the copyable heygen-com/skills surface: copy false) as recorded in the capability assessment (sl8-resesarch@559a1305). The wording was written for HeyGen's own voice and avatar engines and has not been run on our fal routes.

rows.use: Step 3, a presenter portrait from the eight descriptors when no photo is given; fal-ai/nano-banana-pro by default
rows.prompt: Photoreal studio portrait, {pose_words}, of a {age} {gender} of {ethnicity} appearance: {appearance}. Facing the lens squarely, calm neutral face with lips together, soft even light, a plain {background} backdrop, nothing covering the face, no lettering anywhere. {style} look, framed {orientation}. An invented person, not anyone real.

rows.use: Step 6 starting point: a product demo of about 60 s (about 150 words once filled)
rows.prompt: Meet {product}, the simplest way to {main_benefit}. <break time="1s"/> My name is {presenter}. <break time="0.5s"/> In the next minute you will see three moves. <break time="1s"/> Move one: {first_move}. <break time="0.5s"/> Move two: {second_move}. <break time="0.5s"/> Move three: {third_move}. <break time="1s"/> Teams used to spend {old_time} on this; with {product} it takes {new_time} instead. <break time="0.5s"/> Want to try it? <break time="1s"/> Go to {website_spoken}.
rows.from: heygen/retired-avatarvideo-8ce216@Script template: Product Demo (60 seconds, ~150 words)

rows.use: Step 6 starting point: the opening of a tutorial, about 90 s (about 225 words once filled)
rows.prompt: This lesson is about {topic}. <break time="0.5s"/> My name is {presenter}, and I will walk you through it step by step. <break time="1s"/> When we finish, you can {outcome_a}, {outcome_b} and {outcome_c}. <break time="1s"/> We begin with the groundwork. <break time="1.5s"/> {part_one} <break time="1s"/> With {idea} in place, the next piece is {next_piece}. <break time="1.5s"/> {part_two} <break time="1s"/> One last piece remains: {last_piece}. <break time="1.5s"/> {part_three} <break time="1s"/> That covers what you need to begin. <break time="0.5s"/> Leave your questions below.
rows.from: heygen/retired-avatarvideo-8ce216@Script template: Tutorial Introduction (90 seconds, ~225 words)

rows.use: Step 6 starting point: an announcement of about 30 s (about 75 words once filled)
rows.prompt: Some good news today. <break time="0.5s"/> {announcement} is here. <break time="1s"/> For you that means {gain_a}, plus {gain_b}. <break time="0.5s"/> From {date} on, you can {capability}. <break time="1s"/> The details are at {location_spoken}. <break time="0.5s"/> Tell us how it works for you.

rows.use: Step 6 rhythm: moving from one section to the next
rows.prompt: Thanks for joining this overview. <break time="1s"/> We will look at three parts of the product. <break time="0.5s"/> The home screen comes first. <break time="1.5s"/> Everything there is built to stay out of your way. <break time="0.5s"/> Most tasks take a single tap.

rows.use: Step 6 rhythm: building to a reveal
rows.prompt: For a while now, we have kept something quiet. <break time="1s"/> It took the whole team most of a year. <break time="1.5s"/> Today we can finally show you <break time="0.5s"/> the new assistant.

rows.use: Step 6 rhythm: a short list, one item per beat
rows.prompt: You get three things with it. <break time="0.5s"/> It is fast. <break time="0.5s"/> It is dependable. <break time="0.5s"/> It is easy to learn. <break time="1s"/> We will take them one by one.

rows.use: Step 6: a single pause between two thoughts
rows.prompt: Thanks for being here. <break time="1s"/> Here is what changed this week.

rows.use: Step 6: spoken forms for --say (the voice reads them; captions and overlays keep the written form)
rows.prompt: {"API": "A P I", "SQL": "sequel", "Kubernetes": "koo-ber-net-eez", "acme.com": "acme dot com", "2026": "twenty twenty-six", "40%": "forty percent"}

rows.use: Step 11, only on a talking-head route that takes a prompt (not veed/fabric-1.0): delivery for lively content
rows.prompt: Leans a little toward the camera and talks with open, moving hands.

rows.use: Step 11, only on a talking-head route that takes a prompt: the low-key default delivery
rows.prompt: Small nods on the key words, steady gaze, relaxed shoulders.
